_note: CUST-HV V8a — slider content + publish rules. `content`: normalizer cases (PHP StorefrontSliderNormalizer ↔ both TS twins; key order is part of the contract). `publish`: SliderPublishRules / sliderPublishIssues; `media` maps mediaId → encoded-channel bounds {min,max} (already widened by the encoding margin) or null; an id missing from the map has no evidence. `expected` lists {path, code} in report order, paths relative to the section content.

content.name: a list is not an object
a slide without a media reference drops whole
a slide with an invalid media id drops whole
a url instead of a media reference never survives
minimal slide gets a positional id
full slide keeps canonical key order
fit contain is dropped from the slide picture
slide picture keeps alt and decorative
mobile shares the slide alt: stored decorative without alt or fit
focal crop rotate survive on the picture
extra keys on the slide and picture never survive
button with label and internal link
button with label and https link
button draft with a label only is kept
button draft with a link only is kept
button with an unsafe link and no label drops
button with an unsafe link keeps the label
button style and colour are not accepted yet
overlay alpha steps: 7, 95, 0, string and null all drop
overlay colour falls back to the overlay role
align accepts the closed list only
invalid ids fall back to the position
non-object slide entries are skipped but still count for the position
a duplicate does not use a slot
autoplay with the default interval stores no interval
autoplay with an integral float interval
intervals below five or off the list drop
transition fade and none are stored, slide and unknown are not
behaviour that is a list is ignored
behaviour with no slides is not stored

publish.name: one slide is a hero, not a slider
no slides at all
two slides with no text need no evidence
a dark picture proves the automatic white
a picture with no evidence is unprovable at the media path
a picture with null evidence is unprovable
a full-range picture cannot prove any automatic colour
a strong dark overlay makes the full-range picture provable
a weak overlay does not
explicit dark text over a dark picture fails at the text path
explicit white text over a dark picture passes
explicit white text over a light picture fails
a light picture proves the automatic black
the phone picture widens the judged range
a phone picture without evidence is unprovable
a palette overlay role is judged by the stored palette
a brand-coloured overlay is judged by the brand
an incomplete button alone is not text
a complete button is text
only the failing slide is reported
each failing slide is reported at its own index
